name: T58 ES VWMA Trend Pullback -- Full Pipeline optimized (vwma31/86, ema458/244, rsi19/9, 1H), set risk at 0.85% -- No Sunday Trading
description:
Variant of the original ES1! VWMA Trend Pullback strategy with Sunday trading excluded (filters.days_of_week.exclude = [6], 0=Monday..6=Sunday, the shared cross-source weekday-exclusion mechanism in app.strategy.base -- see resolve_excluded_days_of_week()/apply_days_of_week_exclusion()). Every bar that falls on a Sunday is forced flat (no new entries, and any position already open going into Sunday will not be closed by this filter itself -- it only blocks new signals, exit logic still runs normally). Entry/exit logic, indicator periods, and risk management are otherwise byte-identical to the original file, so the two can be run side by side (Run & Report, Quick Optimize, or Full Pipeline) and compared directly to see the exact effect of dropping Sunday's (typically thin, gap-prone) session on ES1! futures. Saved as a separate file rather than edited in place so both versions remain independently comparable.

Full Pipeline (walk-forward GA, fastest_payout fitness) re-optimization of the original ES1! VWMA Trend Pullback manual strategy, run against ES1! 1h bars (resampled from 1-minute, Mar 2025-Sep 2026). Dev-period backtest: 42 trades, +$17,262 net (+17.3%) on a $100k account at 0.85% risk/trade, 66.7% win rate, PF 2.44, max DD 3.9%, Monte Carlo eval-pass 89.5% / first-payout 48.8% / risk-of-ruin 14.2% (under the 20% cap), median 25 days to first payout. IMPORTANT: on the true holdout (the most recent ~3.5 months, never seen by the optimizer) this configuration -- and the original, un-optimized version -- both lost money, and the pipeline's ICIR/Bonferroni significance gate did NOT pass. Treat this as a candidate that needs live forward-testing before real capital, not a proven edge. Set risk-per-trade to 0.85% of account equity (Step 04 Risk) when running this -- that is what keeps risk-of-ruin under the 20% cap; the raw GA output before this risk-sizing pass showed 23.5% risk-of-ruin at 1% risk/trade.
